official_certificate.interpretation: The 561 count is scoring awards, including individual modes, not 561 distinct named tasks.

historical_reconstruction.cutoff: Strictly before 00:00:00 UTC of the next calendar day, including October 31.
historical_reconstruction.rank_basis: All 1,596 entries retained in the supplied scoreboard. Current deleted flags do not change the target series if those entries are excluded.

partial_first_solve_notes.major_clock_disagreement: Welcome Robots: notes 19:41:58 versus scoreboard 2026-10-01T14:11:41.749Z. Different semantics or an error cannot be resolved from the files.

limitations: Official certificate, saved scoreboard, and original HTML have different participant denominators (1,602 / 1,596 / 1,590). Reason is not recorded.
A latest scoring-event timestamp is not an export timestamp; no exact snapshot capture time is recorded.
Daily placement is reconstructed from retained events, not a platform archive and not a claim about intraday peaks.
A successful score event proves an award, not that every solution artifact or explanatory walkthrough survived.
CourseStack release_day differs from lane_day in web question identifiers. Both are preserved.
Scoring timestamps and clock-only first-solve notes are not elapsed solve durations.
